source.notes: Native InputFieldContainer consumes INPUT_BORDER_ACTIVE for focused TextArea; captured runtime trace verifies the consumer.

privacy.notes: Native design gallery contains generic labels and placeholder text, no account or message data.

visual.notes: Both original full frames and annotated original-scale crop inspected. Focused border clearly changes; baseline and restoration are identical. Handwriting toolbar disabled before baseline to keep full component unobscured.

annotation.notes: Thin outline surrounds the focused text area without covering its border or content.

unrelatedComponents.notes: Only focused input border changes. Caret, placeholder, counter, error-state field and unfocused borders remain unchanged.

description.notes: Colours the outline of a focused text input.
